verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP docs list "Ask questions about mailbox content" and "Ask questions about specific email threads", and the founder describes it as letting users chat with their inbox, so the inbox Q&A core is documented. The evidence never mentions calendar access or how answers are grounded or cited. missing for 10: calendar coverage, evidence of grounded/cited answers (who said what, outstanding items), in-depth docs beyond a prose capability list, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
